reason: Every persistent truth surface and durable key namespace in production code, registered once at the guard landing. A new persistent write or *Prefix constant must add a reviewed entry before it can pass; the checker has no auto-write mode.

surfaces.reason: The configuration chain is the single truth for declaration and publication facts.
Settlement facts are the live truth; the legacy delivery record is the read-only migration input.
Host-owned approvals and runtime directories under the configured workspace.
Per-run trajectory capture root and its bounded swap directory.
Denial and goal event identities are ordered on the durable ledger; the budget window is its persisted snapshot.
The reflection anchor record carries the state machine's durable position.
Training-capture record files, seal marker and swapped request snapshots.
Local-file KV shard snapshots are the durable backing of the memory tier.
The append-only relation journal and its snapshot are durable relation truth.
The rustviking adapter delegates truth to the external KV tier.
Event segment, index and metadata keys are one durable KV layout; tier_facts is its fact-surface adapter.
Age-fold product facts are addressed by these durable key prefixes.
Commit facts, admission specs, consumption receipts, settle attempts and rejections share one durable log.
Migrated legacy records carry this durable archive identity namespace.
Attention, handoff and reactivation identities are durable fact-chain identities, not a second store.
Approval request files and the evidence mirror are durable across restarts.

non_truth_files.reason: MkdirAll prepares an ephemeral plan workspace root; it is not a durable truth surface.
Benchmark workspace path preparation; verifier scratch data, not product truth.
Benchmark task setup writes fixture files into the ephemeral run workspace.
The in-memory memKV backend holds no disk truth and is rebuilt from the durable tier.
The generation-bound exit-status record is a user-cache hint, read and removed per stop; the pane/tmux is the authority.
Benchmark run artifacts (temp workspaces, task outputs, run directories under gitignored bench/runs/): ephemeral evidence, not a durable truth surface read back as system state.
